== Biography ==
Adelaide was born about 1837.<ref>Based on death 1913 age 76.</ref> She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-1698|Samuel Glasgow]] and [[Unknown-554355|Anne]]. 
<ref>She is mentioned in her father's will as "unmarried daughter Adelaide"</ref> She was likely born at Killycurragh, Derryloran, County Tyrone.
<ref>Father's death place, and her residence at first marriage.</ref>

On 7 Jul 1863 at 2nd(sp?) Cookstown Presbyterian, she married Jackey Smyth of (illegible), Maghera, son of Thomas Smyth.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/3021073323348 Jackey Smyth, Adelaide Glasgow, 1863, Cookstown] at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages</ref>

They had (at least) 4 children: Maggie, Sarah, Andrew, and Henry.
<ref>FamilySearch Irish Births & Baptisms for "Adelaide Glasgow"</ref>

On 11 Jan 1876 at Oritor Presbyterian, as a widow, she married Benjamin Glasgow of Killycurragh, son of George Glasgow, farmer.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/7931b92882457 Benjamin Glasgow, Adelaide Smyth, 11 Jan 1876, Cookstown] at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages</ref>

In about 1895, she moved from Killycurragh to Scotland , liking the Scotch life better than the Irish ways. In Scotland she became a member of the Christian Brethren in Addiewell and Uddingston.
<ref>[https://www.britishnewspaperarchive.co.uk/viewer/bl/0002006/19131011/075/0004 "Mrs Adelaide Glasgow"], ''Mid-Ulster Mail'' - Saturday 11 October 1913, Page 4</ref>

She passed away 21 Aug 1913 age 76 at Bothwell, Scotland after a brief illness.  
<ref>ScotlandsPeople: GLASGOW ADALAIDE, 72, 1913, 625/1 209, Bothwell</ref>
